mode.doc: Arrangement of the copies: Line, Grid or Radial.

spacing.doc: Spacing for Line and Grid (per axis in Grid): Relative steps by the input bounds, Offset by a fixed translation, Endpoint spreads the copies up to a point.

count.doc: Total number of copies, including the first.

relative_offset.doc: Per-axis step as a multiple of the input bounds (Relative spacing).

constant_offset.doc: Fixed translation per step (Offset spacing); also added in Relative spacing.

endpoint.doc: Position of the last copy (Endpoint spacing); the copies are spread evenly from the input to here.

count_z.doc: Grid copies along Z. The grid holds at most 10000 copies in all.

radial_mode.doc: Radial: set the number of copies directly, or derive it from the distance between copies along the arc.

distance.doc: Arc length between neighbouring copies (Radial, Distance).

radius.doc: Distance of the copies from the rotation axis.

angle.doc: Sweep in degrees. A full turn spaces copies evenly; less puts the last copy at the end of the arc.

align_rotation.doc: Rotate each copy to follow the circle.

random_seed.doc: Seed for the per-copy randomness. Each copy draws from (seed, copy number), so adding copies keeps the existing ones.

random_position.doc: Largest random move per axis, either way. Applies to every copy, the first included.

random_rotation.doc: Largest random rotation in degrees about X, Y and Z, either way, about each copy's origin.

random_scale.doc: Largest random change of scale: each copy scales by 1 plus or minus this.

uniform_scale.doc: Use one random scale for all axes; off scales X, Y and Z separately.

random_uv.doc: Largest random shift of U and V per copy, either way.

pack.doc: Output one shared copy of the input and one instance point per copy instead of real geometry. UV offsets and welding are off while packed; Unpack gives the real copies.

output_copy_index.doc: Write the copy number (0 for the first) to the point attribute copy_index.

output_copy_fraction.doc: Write the position along the array, 0 for the first copy and 1 for the last, to the point attribute copy_fraction.

output_copies_group.doc: Write each face's copy number to the face attribute array_copies, so every copy can be picked out.

legacy_fit_length.doc: Hidden. Set by migration from the old Fit Length: the count comes from this length and the step. Negative disables it.

merge_vertices.doc: Weld adjacent copies within Merge Distance.

merge_distance.doc: Maximum distance for welding. Zero disables welding for legacy graph compatibility.

merge_first_last.doc: Also weld the last copy with the first.

uv_offset_u.doc: Shift U on each copy by its copy number.

uv_offset_v.doc: Shift V on each copy by its copy number.
